title: Park24 sets ¥3,000 goodwill payment for people affected by Times Car identity-document image leak
date_note: The page gives only its publication day for the announcement of payment options; the leak itself was disclosed on 25 and 28 September per the same page.
geo_basis: company country as the source states it; pin set at Tokyo
summary: ITmedia reports that Park24, operator of the Times Car car-sharing service, announced how it will pay a goodwill sum after unauthorized access exposed encrypted identity-document images such as driver's licenses. The target group is people for whom access and traces of external transmission were confirmed (約146万件). Current members can choose ¥3,000 in cash or a ¥3,000 car-share e-ticket; former and non-members get ¥3,000 in cash, with notices from 1 December.
plain: Park24 will pay people affected by the Times Car identity-image leak ¥3,000 in cash or, for current members, a ¥3,000 e-ticket, with notices starting 1 December, ITmedia reports.
exec: Park24 has set out payment options for the Times Car leak of identity-document images, reported at 約146万件.
impact: Per ITmedia, 約146万件 with confirmed traces of external transmission.

validation.note: Only ITmedia read, relaying Park24's announcement; Park24's own notice was not opened.

evidence.quote: 対象は、暗号化された運転免許証などの本人確認書類の画像データへの不正アクセスと、外部送信を示す痕跡が確認された人（約146万件）。
見舞金として現金3000円または3000円分のカーシェアeチケットを提供すると発表した。
退会済みや未入会の人には現金で3000円を支払う。12月1日から対象者に順次案内する。

review.note: title said members only; ITmedia says former and non-members are paid too; title now says affected people
